# 2 Chronicles 33 — Disagreement Log

## V.2
- **EMET:** "And-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH according-to-abominations-of the-nations that dispossessed YHWH from-before sons-of Israel."
- **LOGOS:** "And he did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD drove out before the people of Israel."
- **PNEUMA:** "He did evil in the LORD's eyes, following the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
